prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
competitors_mentioned: Florida Building Code High-Velocity Hurricane Zone
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofing company in Miami, and hurricane-rated performance depends as much on the specific roof assembly and permitting as on the installer. For a Miami home, choose a contractor that can document all of the following:

- Active Florida roofing license and Miami-Dade registration  
- General liability and workers’ compensation insurance  
- Miami-Dade County Notice of Acceptance (NOA) or Florida Product Approval for the exact shingles/tile/metal, underlayment, fasteners, and attachments proposed  
- Compliance with the Florida Building Code High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) requirements  
- Pulls the permit in its own name and schedules inspections  
- Provides a written workmanship warranty, manufacturer system warranty, and clear wind-damage exclusions  
- Has recent local reroof references—ideally homes that have gone through major storms

For hurricane resistance, the quote should specify more than “hurricane-rated shingles.” Ask about:

1. Deck condition and re-nailing/fastening requirements  
2. Peel-and-stick or approved secondary water barrier  
3. Drip edge and flashing installation  
4. Roof-to-wall connection upgrades where applicable  
5. Exact fastener pattern, uplift rating, and product approvals  
6. Whether the installation qualifies for a wind-mitigation inspection/insurance discount  

Before hiring, verify the contractor through the Florida Department of Business & Professional Regulation (DBPR), Miami-Dade contractor records, and the Miami-Dade Product Control/NOA database. Get at least three itemized proposals and avoid anyone who will not provide permit, license, insurance, and product-approval documents before deposit.

If you share your roof type—shingle, tile, metal, or flat—and your Miami neighborhood, I can help you compare bids or identify what should be included in a hurricane-rated replacement scope.
